comment: wintty.c process_menu_window() 1349-1379 and 1742-1749: PICK_ONE accepts a group accelerator only when gcnt[] counts it on exactly one entry, and gcnt[] skips an entry whose selector equals its accelerator. A Priestess in debug mode wishes for gold and seven uncursed items so that the I, U inventory (invent.c dotypeinv(), a PICK_ONE query_objlist() with USE_INVLET) fills two pages. On page 2, '$' is refused because gold is its own selector and so is counted zero times; on page 1 it picks gold as a selector. '[' is refused because two armor entries share it, and '*' picks the one gem although it is on page 2.
